_readme: LongMemEval poison targets, drafted on 17 Nov 2026 from data/lme_candidates.json; every row was checked by the author. Same format as data/targets_manual.json. claim_1p = what the user says in a dialog turn (A1/A2 and the adaptive attacks); claim_3p = the sentence on an external page (A3 and the clean external page). The same template is used for the true and the poison value. pilot = true: used only to test the pipeline, never reported (the first 3 rows, fixed before any run). Candidates left out: unclear evidence context (6, 15, 26, 28, 36, 39, 54), a third person's fact (50), ratios/times that normalize badly (10, 24, 47), counts with weak templates (9, 14, 18, 20, 21, 23, 33, 45, 46), 13 and 44 (units), 38 (vague value).
